frames.title: Step 1: Define the grid
frames.logic: I omit the repeated endpoint of the periodic interval. I check that the grid spacing times the number of points equals the domain length.
frames.code:
import numpy as np
n = 128
length = 2 * np.pi
spacing = length / n
x = spacing * np.arange(n)
k = 2 * np.pi * np.fft.fftfreq(n, d=spacing)
diffusivity = 1.0
assert np.isclose(n * spacing, length)
assert k[0] == 0
print("Grid points:", n, "spacing:", spacing)

frames.title: Step 2: The initial concentration
frames.logic: The constant term sets the mean. Two cosine terms give two spatial wavelengths. I check the mean and transform the field back before introducing evolution.
frames.code:
initial = 1 + 0.4 * np.cos(x) + 0.2 * np.cos(4 * x)
spectrum = np.fft.fft(initial)
assert abs(initial.mean() - 1) < 1e-12
assert np.max(np.abs(np.fft.ifft(spectrum).real - initial)) < 1e-12
print("Initial mean:", initial.mean())

frames.title: Step 3: Evolve one Fourier mode
frames.logic: Diffusion multiplies a Fourier mode by exp(-D k² t). Higher wave numbers decay faster. I check the known concentration profile at one time; this check would catch a missing square on k.
frames.code:
time = 0.3
decay = np.exp(-diffusivity * k**2 * time)
field = np.fft.ifft(spectrum * decay).real
exact = 1 + 0.4 * np.exp(-time) * np.cos(x) + 0.2 * np.exp(-16 * time) * np.cos(4 * x)
assert np.max(np.abs(field - exact)) < 1e-12
assert abs(field.mean() - initial.mean()) < 1e-12
print("Maximum analytical error:", np.max(np.abs(field - exact)))

frames.title: Step 4: Repeat at several times
frames.logic: I keep the same initial spectrum for every time, since each evaluation gives the solution from the initial state. I check mean conservation and the decreasing concentration variation. This is not a time-step convergence study.
frames.code:
times = [0.0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]
profiles = []
variation = []
for sample_time in times:
    decay = np.exp(-diffusivity * k**2 * sample_time)
    profile = np.fft.ifft(spectrum * decay).real
    profiles.append(profile)
    variation.append(np.mean((profile - profile.mean())**2))
assert all(abs(profile.mean() - 1) < 1e-12 for profile in profiles)
assert np.all(np.diff(variation) <= 0)
print("Concentration variances:", variation)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for sample_time, profile in zip(times, profiles):
    ax.plot(x, profile, label=f"t = {sample_time}")
ax.set_xlabel("Position x (dimensionless)")
ax.set_ylabel("Concentration c (dimensionless)")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
